scope: Read-only manual review of 36 completed Case 05 runs; findings below supplement, and do not alter, raw automated scores.
verdict: Useful exploratory diagnostic case. Reviewed normative KG supports recovery of the decisive transfer restriction at low effort. Selected checklist success does not establish complete reasoning or compliance coverage.

source_basis.decisive_restriction: A1-HIA 7 first limb prohibits genetic outward transfers on Article 19(1)(a) irrespective of purpose. The second limb restricts use of consent to overcome Article 8 prohibition only for insurance/employment purposes.
source_basis.general_risk: A-REG 12(1) general likely-high-risk test is separate from Article 12(2) enumerated examples and A1-HIA 8 listed activities.
source_basis.recipient_scope: A-REG 3(2) covers Harrow offering a clinical service to the A1 resident. Non-applicability of Region B sector duties does not remove this Region A analysis.
source_basis.conditional_cure: A-REG 18 requires approved clauses, an exporter assessment of applicable destination law/practice, and effective supplementary measures where necessary. Clauses alone do not establish full compliance.
source_basis.hosting_scope: A1-HIA 6 uses transfer-purpose wording, while A1-HIA 8 expressly describes an outside agent. Independent-custodian status alone is an incomplete explanation of the Section 6 boundary.

core_rule_failures.issue: Incorrectly supports consent route because purpose is treatment rather than insurance/employment.
Incorrectly supports consent route; confuses the two A1-HIA 7 limbs.
Incorrectly supports genetic outward-transfer consent route.

core_rule_success: All six low-effort normative-KG runs correctly block the consent-based transfer. The three incorrect citation-graph decisions hold for review rather than approve the transfer, so these are not observed false go-aheads.

high.finding: All preserve the general Article 12(1) high-risk question as undetermined separately from absent listed triggers.

low.finding: All conclude that no assessment is required from absent listed triggers, without adequately resolving the general high-risk test. This does not prove an assessment definitely was required.

additional_multi_graph_defects.issue: Treats Article 18 destination-law assessment as completed on supplied facts/model answer and makes execution of clauses the main remaining action. Also marks security met with ongoing controls left as confirmations.
No separate Article 11 notice, Article 13 records or Article 14 security findings. Marks Article 5 principles/accountability met on limited supplied evidence.
Region A security reasoning explicitly excludes Harrow's own Region B processing, despite potential Article 3(2) recipient duties.
Recorded conclusion issues include 15 passage IDs not shown to the supervisor. Separate from checklist score.
Recorded conclusion issue: shortened alternative-route name does not exactly match existing route.
Recorded conclusion issues: omitted Region B health-record and Region A impact-assessment gates in route plan.

low_other_completeness: All 12 low-effort runs underanalyse Harrow's independent Region A custodian responsibilities. Low single/KG runs also omit broader notice/records/general-risk reasoning; run9 genuinely omits professional secrecy analysis. Multi/KG run9 has stronger remaining-duty coverage than run8.

scorer_false_negatives.finding: Correct prohibition appears in outward-transfer reasoning, but scorer selects a narrower sensitive-processing finding with met status.
Correct scope finding explicitly excludes data-host/Section9 duties but cites B-HRA2/3 rather than B-HRA9.
Correct consolidated non-applicability finding cites definitions/application rather than operational duties.
Correct consolidated non-applicability finding cites B-HRA2/3.
Explicitly excludes Sections4-8 and Section9, but cites B-HRA2/3.

proposed_hand_repairs_not_applied.note: These examples demonstrate rubric sensitivity. Do not substitute selectively corrected scores for a uniform independent adjudication of all configurations.

region_b_interpretation: All 12 high/medium single-agent runs correctly explain non-applicability in applicability/engagement reasoning. Raw zero scores for structured operational-duty findings should not be described as failure to understand Region B law.

other_substantive_failure.issue: Treats clinical portal/recordkeeping as computing-provider services and rules out Article18, creating a false obstruction despite a correct current-transfer refusal.

interpretation_of_existing_readme: All24 runs is only true for high/medium, not all36.
Graph made no difference to single mean is true for medium only; high increases from12.67 to14.00 and low from9.00 to14.67.
Graph decides correctness is too causal and broad for three repetitions on one constructed scenario.
Single agent missed Region B requirements should specify structured finding/citation misses, because scope reasoning often is correct.
Medium matched/exceeded high should explicitly refer to selected automated checklist scores; manual risk reasoning regressed.
All verified findings means reference integrity, not substantive legal correctness.
thesis_positioning: Describe a purpose-designed fictional cross-corpus stress test comparing runtime citation retrieval with a reviewed normative KG. Report raw selected-check agreement, final-decision agreement, manual reasoning/completeness findings, latency and partial token usage separately. Retain the draft/post-run key status and known omitted failed attempt.
recommended_next_study: Freeze and author-review the key/manual rubric before evaluating new cases.
Adjudicate correct consolidated reasoning and explicit-duty findings under architecture-neutral criteria.
Capture complete token usage for every API invocation, retries and failed attempts, plus cache details.
Record effort/token cap/model/prompt/corpus/graph/code hashes in every run; equalize output cap when comparing effort.
Test more case types, including permitted transfers and cases in which a reviewed KG is incomplete or misleading.
Include graph generation and human-review costs separately from recurring query cost.
